title: Two escape rates for negative eigenvalues of quantum graphs with a shrinking core
summary: We study the negative spectrum of the Laplacian on a metric graph with general vertex matching conditions and with two length scales: a compact core whose edges have length of order a small parameter $ε$, together with finitely many edges of infinite length. As $ε\to0$, some negative eigenvalues may escape to $-\infty$, and we describe precisely how. There are exactly two rates of escape, $ε^{-1}$ and the fractional rate $ε^{-2/3}$.
